1 = NEW VIDEO FROM THIS WORKFLOW
2 = OLD VIDEO FROM THE MEDIA LOADER

Attention backend

sage fp8 cuda++ is the fastest path on a recent NVIDIA card, but it
needs Sage Attention installed. If the console says it is missing,
switch this to 'auto' -- the graph runs either way.

No negative prompt on H3

H3 runs at CFG 1: the sampler reads the positive only, a negative
has nothing to push against.

NAG cannot help either. It guides inside a CROSS-attention, and H3
has none -- text, video and audio run as one joint sequence. The
Polyhedron NAG node refuses H3 and says so in the console, so this
template has no NAG node.

To keep something out of the picture, describe what you DO want.

Load Model: select
1 = ref2va  -- reference pictures (REFS)
2 = fl2va   -- text, first/last frame (T2V, KEYFRAMES)
3 = a ref2va merge (Singularity)

PICTURES
T2V: the three loaders stay BYPASSED.

Minimax_h3_ref2v: for Image to Video (4 steps)
Minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo: for Text to Video (8 steps // 4 steps)

🛈 I use all of it simultaneously with 8 Steps. Seems to be ok. :)

nodes.title: HOW THIS WORKFLOW RUNS
widgets_values: HOW THIS WORKFLOW RUNS -- fox T2V

THE CINE TIMELINE -- fox T2V

- One run renders the whole timeline: three shots in 5.875 s (141 frames),
  cuts at 1.75 s and 3.50 s. A clip is 4 s at least, so the three ~2 s
  parts are shots inside one clip.
- The CLIP Text Encode holds the fixed parts (segment 1 = triggers, look,
  scene, light; segment 2 = subject, mood). The timeline places {pos_1} /
  {pos_2} and adds camera and motion per shot -- 'prompt the run will
  produce' shows the exact text.
- Seed node FIXED (2094697665): every variant renders the same noise.
- Upscale: Universal Neutral, refine BEFORE the pixel pass, no restore;
  the Filter after the interpolation sharpens lightly (0.4).
- Interpolate: the Timeline's cuts pin shows it where the shots change; it
  holds the frame at each cut, no dissolve (cut_guard 0.1 is the fallback).
- Saves go to today's folder; the INTERP clip is named by the timeline
  (PH_<time>_fox_t2v_whole) and lands on the
  timeline's track.

THIS VARIANT -- text only (fl2va, Load Model select 2).

widgets_values:
AUDIO LOCK -- bypassed
A given sound track is held, the picture is made to it.
To use: un-bypass Audio Lock AND its Media Loader,
load the sound in the loader.

SECOND PASS -- bypassed
H3 Latent Upscale -> Second Pass Hold -> sampler 2:
a second pass on a larger latent; Hold keeps a carried
head in place. To use: un-bypass all three.
